about: GPU still reference renders of the Courtyard House (FLR-T-13.14, FLR-T-13.18, FLR-T-13.15, FLR-ADR-040): the editor's GPU still — its scene as apps/web/src/editor/three/still/gpu/scene.ts builds it from the worker's glTF export (prepareHouse, stillScene, perspectiveOf, roomCamera/presetCamera) and traced by gpu/tracer.ts's traceStill (three-gpu-pathtracer's WebGPUPathTracer, 6 bounces, multiple importance sampling, the library patched by patches/three-gpu-pathtracer@0.0.27.patch) with `radiance` — read back before the meter, the tone curve and the denoiser, as linear RGB in cd/m², box-filtered from 320 × 240 to 80 × 60. Little-endian float32, three a pixel, rows top to bottom. The export is the worker's with doors closed and its lighting 'All on'; the sky is skyLight(sky, the sun at `at` at the document's site, true north 0). Re-record them whenever the library, its patch or the still's scene changes: patches/README.md.
device: Apple M4 Pro (apple metal-3), headless Chromium WebGPU
